sloka: ततस्तमादाय तदा स मेने हरीन्द्रमिन्द्रोपममिन्द्रवीर्यः।अस्मिन् हृते सर्वमिदं हृतं स्यात् सराघवं सैन्यमितीन्द्रशत्रुः ।। ६.६७.७२ ।।
transliteration: tatastamādāya tadā sa mene harīndramindropamamindravīryaḥ।asmin hṛte sarvamidaṁ hṛtaṁ syāt sarāghavaṁ sainyamitīndraśatruḥ ।। 6.67.72 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter the heroic Rakshasa king having held Sugriva in the battle went, duly praised (by Rakshasas), hearing the roaring sounds of gods in heaven wondering at Sugriva's capture.
